title: Formula 1 World Championship (1950-2026)
subtitle: F1 data from 1950-2026, updated after every race
description:
A complete Formula 1 statistics dataset spanning every World Championship race, driver, constructor, and result from 1950 through the current 2026 season. This is built on top of the well-established 1950-2024 F1 dataset structure, extended with full 2025 season data and every completed round of 2026, and is kept current - updated after every race weekend.

The dataset covers 14 relational tables: races, results, qualifying, sprint results, pit stops, lap times, driver and constructor standings, plus lookup tables for drivers, constructors, circuits, seasons, and finishing status codes. It's designed for anyone doing F1 analysis, predictive modeling, or historical research - from career trajectories and team performance over decades to lap-by-lap race pace in recent seasons.

See the README for full details on what's new in this version, known data gaps, and the update methodology.

GitHub: https://github.com/Arths17/f1-dataset — source of the update scripts, and where you can open issues or PRs to contribute.

resources.description: One row per race: season, round, circuit, name, date/time, and practice/qualifying/sprint session schedule.

fields.name: raceId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the race (primary key).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Official race name, e.g. 'Monaco Grand Prix'.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Race start time (UTC), or \N if unknown.

fields.name: sprint_date
fields.description: Sprint race date, or \N if the weekend had no sprint.

resources.description: Race classification results: grid position, finishing position, points, laps, race time, fastest lap, and finishing status per driver per race.

fields.name: resultId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the result row (primary key).

fields.name: number
fields.description: Car number used in this race.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Final classified finishing position, or \N if unclassified (DNF/DSQ/etc).

fields.name: positionText
fields.description: Finishing position as text; non-numeric codes like 'R' (retired), 'D' (disqualified), 'W' (withdrew) for unclassified results.

fields.name: positionOrder
fields.description: Numeric finishing order for sorting (classified drivers first, by position, then unclassified).

fields.name: time
fields.description: Race finishing time (leader) or gap to leader, or \N if not applicable.

fields.name: fastestLap
fields.description: Lap number of the driver's fastest lap, or \N.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Rank of this driver's fastest lap among all drivers in the race, or \N.

fields.name: fastestLapSpeed
fields.description: Average speed on the fastest lap (km/h), or \N. Not available from the data source for 2025/2026 races.

fields.name: statusId
fields.description: Foreign key to status.csv describing how the race ended for this driver.

resources.description: Qualifying session results per driver per race, including Q1/Q2/Q3 times and grid position.

fields.name: qualifyId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the qualifying result (primary key).

fields.name: position
fields.description: Qualifying position, which sets the starting grid.

fields.name: q1
fields.description: Q1 session lap time, or \N if not set.

fields.name: q2
fields.description: Q2 session lap time, or \N if the driver didn't advance to Q2.

fields.name: q3
fields.description: Q3 session lap time, or \N if the driver didn't advance to Q3.

resources.description: Sprint race classification results, same structure as results.csv, for race weekends with a sprint format.

fields.name: resultId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the sprint result (primary key).

fields.name: number
fields.description: Car number used in the sprint.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Final classified sprint finishing position, or \N if unclassified.

fields.name: positionText
fields.description: Finishing position as text; non-numeric codes for unclassified results.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Championship points scored in the sprint.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Sprint finishing time (leader) or gap to leader, or \N.

fields.name: fastestLap
fields.description: Lap number of the driver's fastest lap in the sprint, or \N.

fields.name: statusId
fields.description: Foreign key to status.csv describing how the sprint ended for this driver.

resources.description: Individual pit stop records: which lap, stop number, time of day, and duration per driver per race.

fields.name: stop
fields.description: Stop number for this driver in this race (1st stop, 2nd stop, etc).

fields.name: lap
fields.description: Lap on which the stop occurred.

fields.name: time
fields.description: Time of day the stop occurred.

resources.description: Lap-by-lap timing per driver per race (position and time each lap). Does not yet include 2025/2026 data - see README.

fields.name: position
fields.description: Driver's race position at the end of this lap.

resources.description: Championship standings for drivers after each race: cumulative points, position, and wins.

fields.name: driverStandingsId
fields.description: Unique identifier for this standings row (primary key).

fields.name: raceId
fields.description: Foreign key to races.csv - standings as of after this race.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Cumulative championship points through this race.

fields.name: wins
fields.description: Cumulative race wins through this race.

resources.description: Championship standings for constructors (teams) after each race: cumulative points, position, and wins.

fields.name: constructorStandingsId
fields.description: Unique identifier for this standings row (primary key).

fields.name: raceId
fields.description: Foreign key to races.csv - standings as of after this race.

fields.name: points
fields.description: Cumulative championship points through this race.

fields.name: wins
fields.description: Cumulative race wins through this race.

resources.description: Points scored by each constructor in each race, aggregated across both of their drivers.

fields.name: constructorResultsId
fields.description: Unique identifier for this row (primary key).

fields.name: points
fields.description: Total points scored by the constructor in this race.

fields.name: status
fields.description: 'D' if the constructor was disqualified from this race, otherwise \N.

resources.description: Driver lookup table: name, code, permanent number, date of birth, and nationality.

fields.name: driverId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the driver (primary key).

fields.name: driverRef
fields.description: URL-safe reference slug for the driver.

fields.name: number
fields.description: Permanent car number, or \N if none assigned.

fields.name: code
fields.description: Three-letter driver code, or \N if none assigned.

resources.description: Constructor (team) lookup table: name and nationality.

fields.name: constructorId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the constructor (primary key).

fields.name: constructorRef
fields.description: URL-safe reference slug for the constructor.

resources.description: Circuit lookup table: name, location, country, and geographic coordinates.

fields.name: circuitId
fields.description: Unique identifier for the circuit (primary key).

fields.name: circuitRef
fields.description: URL-safe reference slug for the circuit.

fields.name: alt
fields.description: Altitude in meters. Set to 0 as a placeholder for circuits added after 2024 where this data isn't available from the source API.
